u: 1.0 LISTENING SKILLS
1.1 Understand meaning in a variety of familiar contexts
1.1.1 Understand with little support the main ideas in simple longer texts on a range of familiar topics
1.1.2 Understand with little support the specific details and information in simple longer texts on a range of familiar topics
1.2 Use appropriate listening strategies in a variety of contexts
1.2.1 Guess the meaning of unfamiliar words from clues provided by other known words by context on a range of familiar topics
2.0 SPEAKING SKILLS
2.1 Communicate information, ideas, opinions and feelings on familiar topics
2.1.1 Ask about and explain information from simple texts
2.1.2 Ask about and explain information from simple processes
2.1.3 Ask about, describe and give respond to future plans or events
2.1.4 Express and respond to common feelings such as happiness, sadness, surprise and interest
2.2 Communicate appropriately to a small or large group on familiar topics
2.2.1 Express feelings or simple opinions about a story, event or experience
3.0 READING SKILLS
3.1 Understand a variety of texts by using a range of appropriate reading strategies to construct meaning
3.1.1 Understand the main points in simple longer texts on an increased range of familiar topics
3.1.2 Understand specific details and information in a variety of text types on a range of familiar topics
3.1.3 Use with little or no support familiar print and digital resources to check meaning
3.2.1 Read, enjoy and give a personal response to fiction or non-fiction and other suitable print and digital texts of interest
4.0 WRITING SKILLS
4.1 Communicate through print and digital media on familiar topics
4.1.1 Explain simple content from what they have read or heard
4.1.2 Explain and give detailed information from variety of materials
4.1.3 Express and respond to opinions and common feelings such as happiness, sadness, surprise and interest
4.2 Communicate with appropriate language, form and style
4.2.1 Punctuate written work with reasonable accuracy
4.2.2 Spell written work with reasonable accuracy
